scan_enabled.description: Whether to automatically scan for arrays. If false, the SCAN directive is commented out.

device_list.description: List of devices or patterns to scan for arrays (e.g., 'partitions containers', '/dev/sd*').

auto_assemble.description: Whether to automatically assemble arrays. If false, the AUTO directive is commented out.

homehost.description: Homehost name for array identification. Use 'auto' for the system hostname.

arrays.description:
List of MD RAID arrays to configure. Each entry defines an array to monitor, assemble, or create.
"items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"path": {"type": "string", "description": "Path to the array device (e.g., /dev/md0)"}, "metadata": {"type": "string", "description": "Metadata version (e.g., 1.2)"}, "spares": {"type": "number", "description": "Number of spare disks"}, "name": {"type": "string", "description": "Array name"}, "uuid": {"type": "string", "description": "Array UUID"}}}
